COM.name: COM_INPUT_FIRMWARE_VERSION
COM.comment:
//----------------------------COM : Modbus RTU, input (equipment to PLC)
IR 0x3001 | 3+5+8 bits (major+minor+revision)

COM.name: COM_INPUT_LEVEL_ALARM
COM.comment: IR 0x3004 | 0 no alarm, 1 alarm, 65535 = not connected

COM.name: COM_INPUT_RUN_ACTUAL
COM.comment: HR 0x4007-0x4008 | Current run | REAL ml (volume mode) / UDINT ms (time mode)

COM.name: COM_INPUT_RUN_TOTAL
COM.comment: HR 0x4009-0x400A | Accumulated run | REAL ml (volume mode) / UDINT ms (time mode)

COM.name: COM_OUTPUT_RUN
COM.comment:
//----------------------------COM : Modbus RTU, output (PLC to equipment)
Coil 0x0001 | 0 stop, 1 start

COM.name: COM_OUTPUT_SAVE_FLASH
COM.comment: Coil 0x0003 | 1 s pulse, saves pump parameters to flash

COM.name: COM_OUTPUT_RUN_SETPOINT
COM.comment: HR 0x4005-0x4006 | Run setpoint | REAL ml (volume mode) / UDINT ms (time mode), 0 = continuous

COM.name: COM_OUTPUT_CALIBRATION_COEFFICIENT
COM.comment: HR 0x400B-0x400C | Flow / speed calibration coefficient | ml/min or rpm

INT.name: HMI_LOCAL_REQUEST
INT.comment:
//----------------------------Control mode
From HMI : local request (pulse or maintained)

INT.name: HMI_AUTO_REQUEST
INT.comment: From HMI : auto request, releases the individual HMI local

INT.name: GLOBAL_LOCAL_HMI
INT.comment: From UPI_LOCAL_HMI : global HMI local active

INT.name: LOCAL_HMI_INDIVIDUAL
INT.comment: Memory : individual HMI local, set by local request, reset by auto request

INT.name: LOCAL_HMI
INT.comment: Result : equipment in HMI local (individual or global)

INT.name: AUTO
INT.comment: Result : no local mode, commands come from the functional units (UPI)

INT.name: CMD_RUN
INT.comment:
//----------------------------Commands (to pump), from the active source
0 stop, 1 start

INT.name: CMD_CLOCKWISE
INT.comment: 0 counterclockwise, 1 clockwise

INT.name: CMD_VOLUME_MODE
INT.comment: 0 time mode, 1 volume mode

INT.name: CMD_SPEED
INT.comment: rpm

INT.name: CMD_RUN_SETPOINT
INT.comment: ms (time mode) or ml (volume mode), 0 = continuous

INT.name: CMD_SAVE_FLASH
INT.comment: 1 s pulse to coil 0x0003, saves pump parameters to flash

INT.name: RUN_SETPOINT_MS
INT.comment: Run setpoint as an integer, format used by the pump in time mode

INT.name: FLASH_SAVE_REQUEST
INT.comment:
//----------------------------Parameters (from the HMI, in local HMI)
Flash save request (rising edge used)

INT.name: PARAM_WRITE_ENABLE
INT.comment: 1 = take the HMI parameters into PA and write the configuration to the pump

INT.name: PARAM_MAX_MOTOR_SPEED
INT.comment: HMI value | rpm

INT.name: PARAM_CALIBRATION_COEFFICIENT
INT.comment: HMI value | ml/min or rpm

INT.name: PARAM_FOOT_SWITCH_INPUT_MODE
INT.comment: HMI value

INT.name: PARAM_LIQUID_LEVEL_INPUT_MODE
INT.comment: HMI value

INT.name: PARAM_STATE_OUTPUT_MODE
INT.comment: HMI value

INT.name: PARAM_COMMUNICATION_ADDRESS
INT.comment: HMI value | 1..31

INT.name: PARAM_VALID
INT.comment: HMI parameters usable : address 1..31, baud index 0..7, max speed > 0, calibration coefficient > 0

INT.name: PULSE_500MS
INT.comment:
//----------------------------Write triggers
Square wave, 500 ms period, source of the trigger edges

INT.name: CMD_CHANGED
INT.comment: A command value changed this cycle

INT.name: CMD_TRIGGER
INT.comment: Command channel trigger, 3 s of edges after the last change

INT.name: CONFIG_TRIGGER
INT.comment: Configuration channel trigger

INT.name: PREV_RUN
INT.comment:
//----------------------------Previous command values
Previous values for change detection

INT.name: FBK_FIRMWARE_VERSION
INT.comment:
//----------------------------Feedback (from pump)
3+5+8 bits (major+minor+revision)

INT.name: FBK_HARDWARE_VERSION
INT.comment: 3+5+8 bits (major+sub+reserved)

INT.name: FBK_TEMPERATURE
INT.comment: (raw - 500) / 10 = degC, 65535 = not connected

INT.name: FBK_LEVEL_ALARM
INT.comment: 0 no alarm, 1 alarm, 65535 = not connected

INT.name: FBK_DIGITAL_OUTPUT
INT.comment: Digital output value

INT.name: FBK_RUN_ACTUAL
INT.comment: Current run, ms (time mode) or ml (volume mode)

INT.name: FBK_RUN_TOTAL
INT.comment: Accumulated run, ms (time mode) or ml (volume mode)
